title: TonalEnergy Tuning Log Cents Off Leaderboard
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tonalenergy:tuning cents_off=*
| stats sum(cents_off) as total_value, avg(cents_off) as avg_value by instrument_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks instrument name values by total and average cents off across TonalEnergy tuning log events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `cents_off` values for each TonalEnergy tuning log event and review total and average cents off by instrument name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total cents off.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which instrument name shows the biggest cents off numbers in your TonalEnergy tuning log data.
